name: tracker
note: CMS Phase-2 tracker: the tracker tables of Ember's earlier whole-detector export. Tracks (generalTracks, in collection order) drawn as helices from their reference point to their outermost hit, high purity, pt >= 1 GeV and from the primary vertex (PV0) by default; offline primary vertices; the hits on each track (valid pixel and outer-tracker hits, positions from their clusters, mid-strip on the outer tracker), shown for a selection; the beam spot. Used alone (tracker_only.json writes only these tables), or with hgcal through cms.json. Domain Tracker: region from the hits of the ttbar samples (r <= 110 cm, |z| <= 268 cm), coloured by layer (pT) when chosen. The replay builds the tracks from their hits (grow): a seed of their first 4 hits (Phase-2 tracking seeds mostly from pixel quadruplets), then outwards along the helix. Field: 3.8 T inside the coil (inner radius 295 cm) to |z| = 320 cm, where a helix from a track's reference point reaches HGCalNanoAOD's propagated HGCal entry within 0.23 cm (median; 1.3 cm for 90%) for high-purity tracks above 1 GeV. MTD (earlier export): every BTL and ETL rechit (35k per PU200 event, 0.5 MB in the nano), unticked, coloured by time; preset 'Track time' colours tracks by t0, vertices by t and MTD hits by time. A track's MTD hit is at its mtdX/Y/Z (on a rechit for 98% of tracks at PU200); no track -> rechit link is exported (it would need the extended track's MTD cluster matched back to rechits by cell). No MTD hit truth (truth-graph.md gap 19). Only the leading primary vertex (row 0, the hard scatter for PF and PUPPI) is drawn by default (filter 'index == 0' on a derived row number); the preset 'All vertices' shows every vertex.

truthGap.reason: MTD hit truth is not exported: the hit index's MTD channel is keyed by module and cell, and following the particles that enter the calorimeter covers only 60% of the cells at PU200
